# StateImpact Idaho

> > Regional public media collaboration reporting on state policy, government employment, and legislative issues in Idaho and the Mountain West.

StateImpact Idaho is an NPR-affiliated project providing in-depth coverage of Idaho state government, workforce studies, employee compensation, and policy analysis. The reporting focuses on legislative activities, performance evaluations, and comparative regional studies across Mountain West states.

## Key Topics

- Idaho Legislature
- Office of Performance Evaluations
- Division of Human Resources
- State employee compensation
- Workforce studies
- Wage comparison
- Government employment
- Mountain West states (Arizona, Colorado, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah, Washington, Wyoming)
- Idaho state policy
- Legislative analysis
